segments.contextAfter: When XNU detects a tampered page, it clears the `CS_VALID` bit. With the `CS_KILL` bit set, Endpoint Security terminates the process, preventing the tampered code from executing. Platform binaries and binaries that opted into the hardened runtime typically have the `CS_KILL` bit set.
